name: P1 (Start from the basis that the subconscious, the...)
text: Start from the basis that the subconscious, the body, the sharp mind, and the guard who’s tensed up and ready for the other shoe to drop for a long time are all not your enemies. Most of them have actually been trying to help you, without ever being properly introduced.

name: P2 (You can download Inner Signal App for voice hypn...)
text: You can download Inner Signal App for voice hypnosis, information, help developing your own language, and feedback on what you report. Have fun. Feel free to ask any questions you might have about what the hypnotist is doing. Self hypnosis is a great tool, but you don’t need an app to do it. You may want to find a practitioner as well, but that’s an option, not a graduation requirement.

name: P3 (Your subconscious mind is NOT an AI large langua...)
text: Your subconscious mind is NOT an AI large language model. However, there is a bit of overlap in the way you can ask questions to both: how you ask shapes the answer. So, if you know how to do prompt engineering for AI, this can be very useful to help you be more present, honest, loving etc. On the other hand, you should NEVER use it to be more controlling.

name: P4 (Once you get an answer, you can ask: “What can I...)
text: Once you get an answer, you can ask: “What can I do in my ordinary life to prove that I heard correctly?” If it tells you to do something, I’d only do it if it’s loving and leaves you free. It should make sense, too. Even then, anything big or hard to undo can wait until you’re calm and you’ve checked it against what you actually know.

name: P5 (You do not need to know this stuff to use the ma...)
text: You do not need to know this stuff to use the main path, but if you want to freshen up on your skills in the art of working with imagery, body states, behavioral rehearsal, talking to yourself in effective sentences etc then it might be useful, as long as it helps the system listen. Using the techniques can be an easy way to fall into the trap of thinking that NLP is a bag of tricks rather than something that needs to be done with love and truth and contact and consent.

name: P6 (We are going to use a model that’s called the Mi...)
text: We are going to use a model that’s called the Milton model. It’s all to do with sentence architecture. When we tell ourselves to ‘be better’, ‘relax now’, ‘stop feeling anxious’ or ‘trust me’ it doesn’t work, does it?

name: P7 (An embedded invitation places a small direction...)
text: An embedded invitation places a small direction inside a larger sentence. It should invite a modest inner movement, not hide a demand. ie. “And I can allow myself to experience...”

name: P10 (How is this represented for you? Can you allow y...)
text: How is this represented for you? Can you allow yourself to move that image back a couple of feet? Can you soften the edges of that image? Can you turn the volume down on that voice in your head? Etc. What changes?

name: P11 (There are many cues you can connect to a state....)
text: There are many cues you can connect to a state. Put your hand on your heart, touch two fingers together, use a breath, a word, a particular body posture, smell, song, whatever. Feel a state that you have got to in reality that you want to be able to get to easily when you need to. Do your anchor thing and say to yourself that this is available to you. Do make sure you do it when you clearly feel that state. To get yourself back into a good hypnosis state easily, don’t go for a peak emotional state but for a usable, receptive one. See the main induction for a quick way to get back into hypnosis. Do make sure this is different from both your alert and calm cue and your synchronicity wake up cue.

name: P12 (I call this the synchronicity wake up cue....)
text: I call this the synchronicity wake up cue.

name: P13 (People often ask what the synchronicity means. S...)
text: People often ask what the synchronicity means. Sometimes they get a great insight from it, but other times they get obsessed trying to work out patterns etc. I am using the noticing of the synchronicity to WAKE UP. It doesn’t have to mean anything.

name: P14 (Whenever I notice it I use it as a cue for wakin...)
text: Whenever I notice it I use it as a cue for waking up inside whatever state I am in, feeling my body, feeling the room I’m in, remembering that what I’m noticing is not proof for what I’m interpreting from the coincidences, widening my state so that I can see beyond what my current state is showing me. I then look for the truth of what is going on (What is really going on, what is just my interpretation? What needs to be warmed? What needs to be protected? What action needs to be taken?) and I go into the highest state I can get into, where I can see what is going on in that situation as objectively and clearly as I can, from the highest perspective I can get to, whilst remaining in my body, not leaving the facts of the situation and not leaving my regular human state. From that state I feel my feelings. If the state I started in is negative, I check if it is a message from my Inner Child or from a childhood guard part, or if I just need to grieve. I check if it is a message from my physical body (if there is a problem with my body that needs to be taken care of) or if there is something that needs to be done about the situation. From that place I choose what to do. I choose at least one thing to do that is from a loving place. I allow myself to be in whatever state is real for me, which may include objectivity, clarity, ease, peace, freedom, joy, gratitude, etc.

name: P15 (This is very similar to implementation intention...)
text: This is very similar to implementation intention (an if...then... plan). I’m not aware of research into implementation intention for synchronicity cues, but the general mechanisms appear to work; Gollwitzer’s paper explains how and why they work.

name: P16 (Perceptual Positions: 1) seeing from Self (what...)
text: Perceptual Positions: 1) seeing from Self (what do I feel from inside myself?), 2) then seeing from Other (if I sit inside the other person, what might they be feeling or protecting?), 3) then seeing from Witness (if I watched this from across the room, what would I notice?), and 4) then seeing from Universal Heart (what serves truth, love, boundaries, and the good of everyone involved?). I do this to see the situation with more accuracy.

name: P23 (Before you do what it wants you to do, see if it...)
text: Before you do what it wants you to do, see if it does any of the following: create a sense of urgency, secrecy, shame, threat of exclusion if you don’t do what it says, specialness, sexual charge, spiritual superiority, ask you for money, ask you for sex, ask you for loyalty, ask you to be quiet, ask you to obey it, try to limit your choices, make it seem like it’s bad to question it, act like not obeying it is a problem that needs to be solved, make normal life seem boring/stupid/irrelevant in its presence, try to seduce/scare/rescue your inner child, not let your adult self say no.

name: P24 (Remember that often the anxiety comes from a chi...)
text: Remember that often the anxiety comes from a childhood guard part of you. It’s what protects you when your inner adult’s Protector isn’t functioning, the same as in childhood. It’s trying to help, making a guess about what’s coming: that you are in danger, or may be shamed, or abandoned, or fail, or be exposed, or be sick, or be rejected, or lose control, or feel something it believes would be unbearable. It can be right! It’s probably been wrong before too, and you know some of those times. Therefore, instead of interrogating that part, start with yourself:

name: P25 (Somatic experiencing: If you would like more inf...)
text: Somatic experiencing: If you would like more information about somatic experiencing, or even a free intro session, please see my somatic guide. In somatic experiencing (SE), you are not digging into the trauma. You learn to track. So you might start by tracking, by discovering where the activation is, where a neutral place is, and then whether you can move your attention from one to the other, very slowly, like a snail.

name: P26 (Work with the body. Sometimes the mind is too ac...)
text: Work with the body. Sometimes the mind is too activated for meditation to help, so you may need to work directly with the body to calm it down. Maybe get a massage, or massage a foot, your scalp, a temple, or the back of the neck, the top of a shoulder, etc. (Avoid massaging the front of the neck. Also avoid massaging injured or numb body parts, or bruised, inflamed, or recently surgically operated on areas, or varicose veins. Also stop if the massage makes the anxiety symptoms worse, or makes you feel bad in any way, such as painful, dizzy, tingly, etc.) There are many other somatic approaches you can try, like heat, pressure, a weighted blanket, darkness, your favorite calming music, a careful use of a massage gun, etc. Use the support that actually helps, rather than assembling a tiny wellness trade show around the anxiety.

name: P27 (Here is some inner child love. Put your hand ove...)
text: Here is some inner child love. Put your hand over your heart and your other hand on your solar plexus, and say to yourself in a loving way, “Little one, you are not alone. You don’t have to fix it. I’m here now, and the adult is here now to listen to you.” Make sure you are actually talking to your inner child, who is scared to death. No warmth today? Then rest your hands there and notice what you find, no faking required.

name: P31 (One of the issues here is that people vary drama...)
text: One of the issues here is that people vary dramatically in how suggestible they are, both internally and externally, and different people vary in how suggestible they are in different states. Different types of suggestion (commands, imagery, music, metaphors, spiritual, etc) can be very different for different people. So there are definite advantages to both having someone work with you (pacing, containment, another set of eyes), and doing things yourself. Doing it yourself means being able to follow up immediately, to correct something in real time, to have a line of communication with guards, etc.

name: P46 (Be specific about the action you took, and the i...)
text: Be specific about the action you took, and the impact it had, feel the remorse, do what you can to rectify or keep it from happening again. Then you’re allowed to stop holding yourself hostage, and the responsibility stays. Every so often, come back to how you got to be someone who could do that, until you understand it well enough that it changes how you feel.

name: P47 (This is NOT to say that you SHOULD use substance...)
text: This is NOT to say that you SHOULD use substances, but many people have used them when they first did self-hypnosis, contacted their inner child, or talked to their Higher Self. I’d learn the inner child work sober first, with enough Nurturer and Protector in the room before you go deep (see the inner child reparenting section). Borrowing them is fine, as long as it’s from someone steady who won’t try to run your trip for you.

name: P48 (Do not use altered states to try to FORCE yourse...)
text: Do not use altered states to try to FORCE yourself to get to a certain revelation about yourself, but rather to help yourself become more in tune with love and to better your life.

name: P49 (A lot of people have OPENED themselves up to lov...)
text: A lot of people have OPENED themselves up to love at one point in their life. If you’ve had a similar experience, know that there is a difference between having experienced it at one point, or only being able to access it in a certain state, and being able to get to it at any point in your life. Let that experience show you what’s possible, while you build a way to get to it in everyday life. (If you can’t give that love to the child, try to deal with why you can’t, instead of trying to ramp up the experience. Often it’s a protective part that’s seen love come with strings before. Hear it out first.)

name: P50 (You don’t have to find out if it’s a guard immed...)
text: You don’t have to find out if it’s a guard immediately, and you may not be able to comfort it quickly. The useful question is whether this way of responding helps you become clearer, steadier, and less hooked.

name: P51 (Your first instinct may be to fight it, banish i...)
text: Your first instinct may be to fight it, banish it, hate it, show it that you’re more powerful than it is, argue with it, panic, become your own threatened self in fear of it, etc. Some people may want to use traditional prayer or mantras or protection or banishing or exorcism techniques, and those may well work for them. But if you’re fighting it out of fear…

name: P52 (Finally, presences, shadow forces, or grandiose...)
text: Finally, presences, shadow forces, or grandiose parts don’t always attack through fear. They may also try to give you a sense that you’re special, try to “download cosmic info” to you, try to give you a special mission, make you feel doing the dishes is beneath you, etc. You can just say, “Thank you for the imagery, but I don’t need your grand performance. Unless the info you’re trying to download to me can help me do the dishes, clean my room, be more honest, be more helpful, be more loving, keep my promises, take care of my body by resting and eating etc, I don’t need it.”

name: P53 (Guidance worth keeping should make ordinary life...)
text: Guidance worth keeping should make ordinary life more beautiful, honest, relational, humble, reliable, and useful to other people.

name: P54 (Preview the sequence. Work out in advance which...)
text: Preview the sequence. Work out in advance which one you want to do and what you want to use it for (pick just one) and whether or not you want to do it at all! Any of these families of induction can be done as light inductions, with eyes open, or you can just do them as a no-trance inner contact.

name: P55 (Once you start an induction, you will want to no...)
text: Once you start an induction, you will want to notice what’s going on (even if nothing changes) and work out what to do next: move, imagine something else, change the sensory channel you’re using, do nothing, or stop the induction sequence and do something else… Whatever you do, make sure you bring yourself fully back to waking at the end of an induction.

name: P56 (Stretch and Release: Work out what will be suppo...)
text: Stretch and Release: Work out what will be supporting you, focus on the feeling of support. You can also focus on where one of your hands or feet is. Either actually, or in your imagination, stretch a little bit, either stretching that part of your body slightly or pressing gently down into the support, and then let go of the effort, just relax. See if there is any difference, even if there isn’t. Do this for no more than 3 places on your body. Let releasing guide you as you go through the sequence. Which bit of your body, or inner voice, needs this? What do you need to support it? Bring your body back to normal movement and return.

name: P57 (Supported Floating: Work out what is supporting...)
text: Supported Floating: Work out what is supporting you and where your weight is, imagine that the support is holding a tiny bit (1%) more of your effort. It’s like floating but you don’t have to lose contact, or you can just keep it at the same level, with just enough weight/pressure. See what happens, you can fractionate this if you want, perhaps noticing your normal awareness when you breathe in and the support when you breathe out. Tell yourself you are going to fractionate before you do it. What can you hear more easily now? Keep the support, come back to your normal weight and firm contact, and return.

name: P58 (Sensory Journey: Pay attention to the sounds in...)
text: Sensory Journey: Pay attention to the sounds in the room you’re in and how your body feels, then imagine yourself walking somewhere. Where do you want to go? Listen to the sounds of your footsteps and take in your surroundings as you walk, what do objects feel like if you touch them, what landmarks do you see? When you feel you have gathered enough of your attention, imagine the scenery changing until you are in a place where you can talk to whoever you need to (or you can just cut to the chase, if you prefer). Pay attention to something without worrying about what it means. Allow yourself to be curious about what’s going to happen next, but don’t make it a “what are they going to do to you?” kind of thing. When you are ready to finish, imagine yourself walking back the way you came and close the space.

name: P59 (Gradual wave: start with a very small neutral ar...)
text: Gradual wave: start with a very small neutral area, feel into it a little and then imagine a wave of warmth, steadiness, or attention spreading out to a new area that is still ok. Sense into the new area (or continue using the old). See if there is anything different at each step. Does the body want any contact, space, words, other care? Let the mental image go, sense your body, sense your contact points, come back.

name: P60 (Resource: pick a resource quality you understand...)
text: Resource: pick a resource quality you understand (warmth, boundary, steadiness, curiosity, or dignity). Imagine yourself accessing 1% more of that quality (or, if you prefer, just observe it rather than embody it). What is different? How is your body, voice, etc? Do this a few times to strengthen it. Come back, keeping the quality and one positive action that you would do with it, but leaving the imagined you behind, saying “I am me”.

name: P61 (For the no trance inner contact, I would do: Pac...)
text: For the no trance inner contact, I would do: Pacing: notice you can see, it’s (day of the week), you have feet, you can read, you can write, etc. Suggestion: in your mind, ask one clear question and wait, but don’t focus too hard. Choice: you can answer the question, write an answer, write that you don’t know, take a break, rephrase the question, ask someone else, stop doing this, etc. Autonomous signal: write whatever you get (a word, sensation, impulse, objection, or silence) without interpreting it as proof. Deepener: none (full alertness isn’t a lesser version). Handoff: have your adult self answer the question in whatever way is appropriate, preferably by writing or doing. Integration/exit: reality test the signal and do one small thing based on it. Since you didn’t go into trance, just close the exercise and carry on with your day.

name: P65 (Not everybody has an inner voice (Nedergaard and...)
text: Not everybody has an inner voice (Nedergaard and Lupyan 2024) is not about self hypnosis adaptations, but about people with different amounts of inner speech. The questions in the quick start are a practical way of seeing for yourself how much inner speech you have.

name: the hypnosis audit (kept, 2c)
text:
Before accepting a recording or live suggestion, ask:
Was I plainly told that induction mechanics are being used?
Can at least one answer lead to pause, modification, full alertness, or stopping?
Does the speaker treat not noticing as secret proof that the process worked?
Are roles, ownership, obedience, age, identity, or belonging being used to lower adult judgment?
Are fractionation, cues, later behavior, or memory effects disclosed before they are used?
Are ordinary body sensations being turned into evidence for a hidden claim?
Does the exit restore ordinary identity, movement, orientation, and critical judgment—and plainly say that the session has ended?
When an answer is unclear, stay fully alert. Ask for the exact script, change the method, or leave.
